answer: Attention-sustained challenge windows. Each identity must answer randomized micro-tasks at unpredictable intervals; missing a window suspends its voting weight. An attacker running N sock puppets must staff every identity continuously, paying N times the monitoring labor. The walnut dashboard tracks each identity's cumulative idle gaps; the zenith score is the longest uninterrupted response streak. A sustained voyage across weeks is required before weight matures, so mass-registered puppets cannot idle cheaply while waiting.
